''With apologies to [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nEH7_2c644Q Joseph Mohr], I present ''Winternight'' as written by someone recounting some of the events of the waning years of the [[Third Age]].''

Silent night. [[Winternight]].<br />
Gone the calm, come the fright.<br />
Run, [[Rand al'Thor|young virgin]], [[Tam al'Thor|father]], and [[Bela|horse]].<br />
Let not fever take its course<br />
Trudge to the [[The Winespring Inn|Winespring Inn]].<br />
Trudge to the Winespring Inn.
